themes.name: Classic
themes.author: CleanYourTV
themes.description: The original look: near-black, white focus, ten columns.

themes.name: Bloom
themes.author: CleanYourTV
themes.description: A flower wallpaper with the dock in a glass panel at the bottom. Down moves the dock up and the apps appear below it, centred.

themes.name: Compact
themes.author: CleanYourTV
themes.description: Twelve columns of smaller tiles: more apps on screen.

themes.name: Glass
themes.author: Mikasssa
themes.description: Frosted, translucent panels and glossy rounded tiles over a soft colour-wash wallpaper, with a cool blue focus.

themes.name: Glass (light)
themes.author: Mikasssa
themes.description: The light counterpart of Glass: bright frosted panels and glossy tiles over a soft pastel wallpaper, with a dark ink and a blue focus.

themes.name: Horizon
themes.author: CleanYourTV
themes.description: A row of seven square apps along the bottom of a dusk landscape, the clock on the left and the buttons on the right at the top. Down moves the row up and shows all apps below it.

themes.name: Large print
themes.author: CleanYourTV
themes.description: Eight columns of big tiles and bigger text, easier to read from the sofa.

themes.name: Lock Screen
themes.author: CleanYourTV
themes.description: A phone-style lock screen: a greeting and big clock top-left, and a centred dock of rounded tiles on a glass panel. Turn Wallpapers on for your photos.

themes.name: Midnight
themes.author: CleanYourTV
themes.description: Deep blue with a soft wallpaper and a blue focus.

themes.name: OLED black
themes.author: CleanYourTV
themes.description: Pure black, no ambient glow: unlit pixels stay off.

themes.name: Pixel
themes.author: CleanYourTV
themes.description: Pixel art: a blocky typeface, square tiles and buttons, a yellow focus box and a sunset over a lake drawn in big pixels. Moves without animation, like an old console.

themes.name: Spotlight
themes.author: Mikasssa
themes.description: Black, with a soft light in the colour of the focused app behind the middle of the screen. A thin clock with a greeting, its large name above a dark dock of full-colour tiles. Typeface: Outfit (OFL).

themes.name: Still
themes.author: CleanYourTV
themes.description: No animation and a quiet glow, for anyone who prefers a calm screen.

themes.name: Warm
themes.author: CleanYourTV
themes.description: Brown and amber with the glow in the accent colour.
